In this episode of Battle Masters; Yahtzee Croshaw, Jesse Galena, Marty Sliva, and Jess Hoops see who can get their Link moving the fastest in a Breath of the Wild - Hyrule Race.
We also give them a lesson in lying, test their nostalgia knowledge, and see who has a cranium for cartoons!

As always the winner receives a free lunch from our sponsor: Big Jonny's Salami Subs
Whether you're looking for a fresh and healthy salad or freshly sliced meat pilled high on daily baked bread, you can always count on Big Jonny's Salami Subs.
